message: Function must return Result[T] — every function must surface success/failure explicitly
rationale: Every function and method must surface success or failure explicitly in its return type. Result[T] makes the contract visible and statically analyzable. Missing annotations, bare types (int, str, None, NoReturn, etc.), and async defs without Result[T] all violate this rule. No exemptions.
remediation: Annotate and return a typed Result[T] (or equivalent explicit result type whose annotation contains Result) with success/failure discrimination. Catch local failures and convert them at the boundary of the fallible work.
